title: Team
meta_description: The team behind Valora's content, tools, and research.
body_html:
Valora is built by a small team with clear ownership. Each person below owns a distinct part of how Valora's content, tools, and research get made and kept accurate. Questions about the site or the work: barot@valorahq.com.

The team

Lena - Content Lead

Researches and writes Valora's guides, articles, and niche pages - the content across this site.

Mira - QA & Content Verification Lead

Reviews every piece of content before it ships: the facts, the sources, and whether the rules it cites are still current.

Sam - CTO, Engineering

Builds and runs valorahq.com - the pages, the calculators, and everything that keeps them fast and reliable.

Owen - Growth & Partnerships

Leads Valora's growth and partnership work.

Arjun - Head of AI Search (AEO/GEO)

Leads Valora's AI search work (AEO/GEO) - how Valora shows up in AI answers and search results.

Ethan - Outbound

Runs Valora's outbound work, connecting with advisors and partners.

Iris - Podcast & Media Outreach

Manages Valora's podcast and media outreach.

Clara - Operations

Keeps the team's operations running day to day.

Jordan - Chief of Staff

Coordinates work across the team and keeps projects moving.

Rina - Consumer Growth

Leads consumer growth - how people find Valora and how the product serves them.
